updates: Added a Data Quantity row to transaction receipts when a data transaction stores a quantity.
Applied the receipt quantity row to both the smedata and default themes.
Built a fresh installable package with the latest receipt and update improvements.
Changed the smedata Buy Data page to use a mobile dropdown for long data-plan categories.
Kept desktop category pills with wrapping so API category names no longer overlap.
Improved mobile plan cards to use two columns with wrapped plan names and safer text rendering.

1.5.09.description: VTUNAIJA margin-rule save fix and cumulative reliability fixes
updates: Included the VTUNAIJA installer in the hosted patch so existing sites get the latest markup-rule columns.
Refreshed sync tables before saving markup rules and show a normal admin error if saving fails.
Added validation-error display and stronger input borders for markup rules.
Made the VTUNAIJA API token field visibly bordered and added placeholder text.
Added a VTUNAIJA API setup screen that creates required categories, services, providers, and API configs from one API token.
Moved VTUNAIJA setup logic into plugin service/controller/view files instead of adding more code to CoreController.
Added php artisan updates:publish to upload the update ZIP and manifest to the FTP update host.
The publisher reads Cyberduck .duck bookmarks, verifies package checksums, uploads the ZIP before the manifest, and verifies the uploaded manifest.
Includes the prior dashboard, transaction idempotency, hosted updater, and update timeline fixes.
